CARD_DESC_1: Deal 2 damage to an adjacent unit.
CARD_DESC_2: Deal 4 damage to an adjacent unit.
CARD_DESC_4: Deal 2d4 damage to an adjacent unit.
CARD_DESC_6: Deal 1d6 damage in a 2-tile line. The second unit takes half.
CARD_DESC_8: Steal the top card from an adjacent unit's deck. Shuffle it into your deck.
CARD_DESC_9: Choose an adjacent unit or yourself. Roll 1d4 and choose that many cards from their deck to **Destroy**.
CARD_DESC_10: Choose a target. A unit on the tile hit chooses 3 times: Take 5 damage or **Destroy** their top card. Adjacent units choose once.
CARD_DESC_11: Choose a target. Deal 1d6 damage. If it damages Health, apply **Burning**.
CARD_DESC_12: Deal 2 damage to an adjacent unit. Gain +2 AP next turn. If you played another Shock this turn, apply **Paralysis**.
CARD_DESC_13: **Choose One:** Deal 2d10 damage to an adjacent unit; or **Destroy** an adjacent wall.
CARD_DESC_14: Choose an adjacent unit or yourself. **Choose One:** Remove a negative status effect; or roll 1d20 and gain that much **Barrier** until their next turn.
CARD_DESC_15: Roll 3d6 ft, then choose an empty tile within that distance to teleport to. Can target through walls.
CARD_DESC_16: Roll 1d10 for your AP next turn. Draw an extra card next turn.
CARD_DESC_17: Copy the next card you play and add it to your hand.
CARD_DESC_18: **Choose One:** Deal damage to an adjacent unit equal to your deck size; or gain **Block** equal to your deck size until your next turn.
CARD_DESC_19: Choose a target. Deal 7 damage. **Destroy** their top card. Apply **Paralysis**. Can target through walls.
CARD_DESC_20: Deal 1 damage to an adjacent unit. If it damages Health, apply **Burning**.
CARD_DESC_21: Choose a target or yourself. **Restore** 2d6 Health.
CARD_DESC_22: **Summon** a **Skeleton** in an adjacent empty tile. It has **Regeneration**. If a unit died there this or last turn, shuffle a random card from its deck into the **Skeleton's**.
CARD_DESC_23: **Summon** a **Golem** in an adjacent empty tile. **Improve** if Shock, Chain Lightning, Flame Hit, Fireball, or Rock Crush was played this turn.
CARD_DESC_24: For the next 3 turns: Whenever you play an Electric or Fire card, add a copy to your hand.
CARD_DESC_25: Create a wall in an adjacent empty tile.
CARD_DESC_26: Gain +7 Holy **Block**. Next turn, roll Xd6 for AP (X = all **Skeletons** and **Hellhounds**).
CARD_DESC_27: Deal 2 damage to an adjacent unit. Deal +2 for each **Hand-related** card played this turn. **Restore** Health equal to damage dealt.
CARD_DESC_28: **Choose One:** Shuffle 2x Punch; or 2x Hand Block into your deck or an adjacent unit's deck.
CARD_DESC_29: Roll Xd20 (X = non-Physical **Defence**). For 10-15: **Draft** Class 1. 16-19: **Draft** Class 2. 20+: **Draft** Class 3. For each Physical **Defence**, flip a coin. Heads: +1 **Max Health**. Tails: -1 **Max Health** to an adjacent unit.
CARD_DESC_30: **Summon** a **Wolf** in an adjacent empty tile. Flip a coin; if Heads, **Summon** another. **Passive:** Take double Piercing damage while this is in your deck or discard.
CARD_DESC_32: Roll 1d4. Take that many extra turns.
CARD_DESC_33: Deal [X] Physical damage to an adjacent unit. This deals 2 damage for each **Hand-related** card in your discard pile. Gain +1 **Luck** and +1 **Max Health**. **Destroy** their top card.
CARD_DESC_34: Choose a target. Deal 1d20 damage to the unit hit, then deal 3 damage in an **AOE** from the tile hit. Can target through walls (**AOE** is blocked).
CARD_DESC_35: Deal 1d6+2 damage to units in all 8 surrounding tiles.
CARD_DESC_36: **Summon** a **Hellhound** in an adjacent empty tile. Takes double Holy damage.
CARD_DESC_37: Choose a target. Roll 1d20. If higher than their Health, **Destroy** them. If lower, apply **Sleep** for 1d6 turns. If already **Sleeping**, **Execute** them.
CARD_DESC_38: **Summon** a **Demon** in an adjacent empty tile. Takes double Holy damage. The unit that kills it **Drafts** a Class 3.
CARD_DESC_39: Deal damage to an adjacent unit equal to your total **Defence**, then lose it all.
CARD_DESC_40: **Choose One:** **Draft** a Class 1; or gain +3 AP next turn.
CARD_DESC_41: Choose a target. Deal 1d10 damage to the tile hit and all 8 surrounding tiles. Gain +3 AP next turn. If multiple units are hit, apply **Paralysis**.
CARD_DESC_42: **Draft** a Class 2. Draw an extra card next turn.
CARD_DESC_44: Deal 1d6 damage to units hit by your next Physical or Piercing attack this turn. If it damages Health, apply **Poisoned**.
CARD_DESC_45: Deal 2 damage to an adjacent unit. Draw a card; if **Hand-related**, it costs 0 AP this turn. This turn, **Hand-related** card effects happen X additional times (X = Flurry of Fists played this turn).
CARD_DESC_46: Transform into a Tortoise until you take 5 Health damage. Gain +5 **Max Health**. **Restore** 5 Health. Shuffle 2x Dispel into your deck. Your **Defence** does not expire. Deal 3 damage to an adjacent unit whenever you **Restore** Health or gain **Defence**.
CARD_DESC_47: Choose an adjacent wall. Gain +X **Fortification** until your next turn (X = contiguous walls connected). Deal 3 damage to all other units adjacent to those walls.
CARD_DESC_48: Deal 3 damage to an adjacent unit. If it damages Health, **Restore** 2 Health and shuffle 1x Vampire Bite into their deck. **Passive:** Take double Holy damage while this is in your deck or discard pile.
CARD_DESC_49: Roll 1d4. **Summon** that many **Kobolds** in adjacent empty tiles.
CARD_DESC_50: **Destroy** an adjacent wall. Gain +6 AP next turn.
CARD_DESC_51: Discard any number of unplayed cards. Draw 2 for each.
CARD_DESC_53: **Destroy** the top 2d4 cards of all other units' decks in the **AOE**.
CARD_DESC_54: Create a Magic Wall in an adjacent empty tile. Surrounding units take and deal double Magic damage, but half Physical damage.
CARD_DESC_55: All units roll 1d4 and move that many tiles in a random direction. Take 1d4 damage if colliding with a unit, wall, or board edge.
CARD_DESC_56: Transform into a Ghost until you take 4 Health damage. **Immune** to Physical and Piercing damage. Gain **Regeneration**. Move freely through walls and units (cannot end turn inside). Take double Holy damage.
CARD_DESC_57: **Choose One:** Push an adjacent wall 1 tile (moving with it), dealing 2d4 damage to units hit (if trapped, they are **Executed**); or pull it 1 tile.
CARD_DESC_59: Choose a target or yourself. **Restore** 1d6 Health.
CARD_DESC_60: Transform an adjacent wall into a Wall minion. Stats improve if it was a Magic Wall.
CARD_DESC_61: **Summon** a **Kobold King** in an adjacent empty tile. Its **Max Health** is 1 + the number of **Kobolds**.
CARD_DESC_62: **Summon** an **Assistant** in an adjacent empty tile. While adjacent, you gain +1 **Luck** and can reroll AP once if at 0.
CARD_DESC_63: Check **Max Health**. 16-20: **Draft** Class 1. 21-25: **Draft** Class 2. 26-30: **Draft** Class 3. 31+: Win the game.
CARD_DESC_64: Gain +1 **Luck**. **Passive:** Gain +1 **Luck** while this is in your deck.
CARD_DESC_65: Gain +2 AP this turn and next turn. Kick costs 0 AP until the end of your next turn.
CARD_DESC_66: **Restore** to **Max Health**. Remove all negative status effects.
CARD_DESC_67: Deal 5 damage to an adjacent unit.
CARD_DESC_68: **Choose One:** Deal 3 damage to a target; or **Restore** 3 Health to a target or yourself.
CARD_DESC_69: Choose a target. Deal 1d6 damage if you **Destroy** your top card. If it was Shock, Flame Hit, or Add Poison, deal +1d6 of that type and apply **Paralysis**, **Burning**, or **Poisoned**.
CARD_DESC_70: **Summon** a **Faerie** in an adjacent empty tile. It has **Regeneration**. While adjacent, non-Faerie units resurrect with 25% of their **Max Health** multiplied by 1d4 and clear all status effects.
